description: This file contains unit tests for functions normalizeUsage, hasNonzeroUsage, and deriveSessionTotalTokens, which operate on usage data objects related to token usage in a system.

methods.name: normalizeUsage
methods.description: Normalizes various token usage object formats into a standard form

methods.name: hasNonzeroUsage
methods.description: Checks if the usage object has any non-zero token counts

methods.name: deriveSessionTotalTokens
methods.description: Calculates total session tokens considering usage and context tokens
